result.summary:
Independently re-derived all three required checks against the real worktree, not CODE-DESIGNER's report.

(1) Grandfather list. Ran `ls -la handoffs/WF03-ISS0258-20260822/` directly. Real output: exactly 10 files, all .md: step-01-issue-fixer.md, step-02-code-designer.md, step-02b-code-design-validator.md, step-03-elixir-dev-MISSING-RETRACTED.md, step-03-elixir-dev.md, step-03b-security-scope-test.md, step-03c-reviewer.md, step-04-test-designer.md, step-04b-test-design-validator.md, step-04c-test-design-validator-regate.md. Compared name-for-name against design doc SS3's 10-path list (and SS3.1's @grandfathered additions): exact match, no more, no fewer. PASS.

(2) Glob diff. Ran the real old glob (`find handoffs -type f -name '*.json' | grep -v registry.json`, 767 files after excluding registry.json, matching handoff_files/0's `Enum.reject(&(&1 == @registry_file))`) and the real new glob (`find handoffs -type f -name 'step*.*'`, 777 files) and diffed the sets with `comm`. REMOVED (old minus new): empty -- zero existing valid .json handoffs newly excluded, confirming the new glob is a strict superset restricted to step*-basenames as the design claims. ADDED (new minus old): exactly the same 10 WF03-ISS0258-20260822 .md paths verified in (1), byte-for-byte -- no other file was newly swept in. Separately grepped the new-glob output for 'registry.json', 'orchestrator.log', 'escalations.yaml': zero matches. Separately found the real redraft-*.md and *-verdict.md files on disk (handoffs/WF03-ISS0198-20260821/redraft-ISS0109-step-02-code-designer.md, handoffs/WF03-ISS0231-20260822/{reviewer-verdict.md,security-verdict.md,test-design-validator-verdict.md}) and intersected them against the new-glob set with `comm -12`: empty -- none of the four are newly matched. All false-positive-sweep-in concerns cleared. PASS.

(3) Implementation code. Grepped the design doc for `^\s*(def |defp |defmodule )`: zero matches. The doc's `case handoff_kind(path) do ... end` block is pseudocode over @spec'd function names with explicit `...existing body, byte-for-byte...` placeholders, not a compilable function body -- consistent with every other section, which is @spec lines, one glob pattern, a data table, and prose. PASS.

All four acceptance criteria of this gate are satisfied. No BLOCKER, no discrepancy found in either direction (grandfather list or glob diff).
